objects.name: mdl
objects.description: Native MDL named scene data: sceneData.<name> (ANARI_STRING) binds a name to attribute0..3 or color; sceneData.<name>.uniform (ANARI_BOOL, default false) enables geometry-constant uniform lookups. Float/color lookups reuse interpolated attributes and return defaults for missing, nonfinite or incompatible uniform data. Integer/matrix lookups remain unsupported. These dynamic names are documented rather than listed as literal query parameters.
